blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. on Wednesday called for stronger cooperation among Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) member-states on food and energy security as the region braces for a potentially super El Niño that could trigger droughts and power shortages. Speaking at the 20th Asean Defense Ministers’ Meeting (ADMM) in Cebu City, Teodoro said there are other issues need to be addressed aside from supply chain challenges caused by conflict outside the region. Teodoro, who chairs the ADMM, stressed the importance of preparing for a super El Niño, warning that its potential effects could also pose security risks. […]...
